verdict.rationale: uv's docs recommend the official setup-uv GitHub Action, which can persist the cache, and describe aggressive caching with configurable cache keys and a 10-100x speed claim. Community reports back the speed, so the fast-CI and cache-restore parts are documented, though thinly. Nothing in the pack documents offline installs, which is half the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of offline-capable installs (e.g. an offline mode), detailed cache save/restore configuration for CI beyond the 'optionally persists the cache' line, and independent CI caching corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can make CI installs fast with a documented cache-restore setup and offline-capable installs

citations.quote: we recommend the official `astral-sh/setup-uv` action, which installs uv, adds it to PATH, (optionally) persists the cache, and more
uv uses aggressive caching to avoid re-downloading (and re-building) dependencies that have already been accessed in prior runs.
you can add cache key entries under `tool.uv.cache-keys`, which covers both file paths and Git commit hashes.
